title: Design System: SARCS Lab — Calm Developer System

display.purpose: Hero and major headlines using Inter.

title.purpose: Card titles and subsection headers using Inter.

body.purpose: Standard prose and descriptions using Inter.

metadata.purpose: Dates, counts, and small tags using JetBrains Mono.

motion.name: hero-noise
motion.purpose: Animated living film-grain overlay on the hero.

motion.name: dock-transition
motion.purpose: Smooth transition between floating hero nav and sticky wide dock.

motion.name: double-scroll
motion.value: Sticky pinned viewport with scroll-driven list translation and ambient AsciiWaves
motion.purpose: Pins recent publications while user scrolls 8 newest items.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Footer 4→2 columns; publications split collapses to single column.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Grids collapse to 1 column; double-scroll unpins to static list.

components.name: Floating Nav / Sticky Dock
components.description: Floating pill buttons with backdrop blur on hero condensing into a wide sticky container dock on scroll.
components.css: .nav-dock { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: rgba(16,22,26,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); border: 1px solid rgba(233,237,241,0.14); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; }

components.name: Noise Overlay
components.description: Animated living film-grain noise canvas overlay.
components.css: .hero-noise-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: overlay; }

components.name: Pinned Publications Double-Scroll
components.description: 100vh pinned sticky container with left-centered publications and ambient AsciiWaves.
components.css: .pinned-pubs-section { position: relative; min-height: 250vh; } .pinned-pubs-sticky { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; }

narrative.overview: Modeled on a modern, quiet developer aesthetic referencing DeepSeek Harness. Features a scoped 16:9 hero Grainient WebGL window with animated noise overlay, wide dynamic floating-to-dock navigation, pinned double-scroll publications with ambient AsciiWaves, unboxed typography, elevated text contrast with backdrop blur, and a spread-out multi-column footer.
keyCharacteristics: 16:9 hero Grainient WebGL window with dark scrim overlay, animated film-grain noise, and smooth bottom dissolve.
Unboxed hero typography directly over the subtle gradient background.
Solid substrate background on all non-home pages without WebGL mounting.
Floating pill nav with backdrop blur transitioning to wide sticky container dock on scroll.
Pinned double-scroll Recent Publications section with ambient AsciiWaves.
Elevated WCAG AA/AAA text contrast with backdrop blur on cards and chips.
dos: Do scope WebGL Grainient and NoiseOverlay to the home 16:9 hero window and keep other pages on solid substrate.
Do ensure all text colors exceed WCAG contrast thresholds against actual rendered backgrounds.
Do maintain smooth transitions for the floating-to-dock navigation.
Do provide non-pinned static fallbacks for double-scroll on mobile and for prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't mount WebGL canvas on non-home pages.
Don't place artificial labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't enclose hero text in heavy card boxes.
